candidates.title: Misc. bug: /props publishes the randomized media_marker, defeating PR #21962's collision defense
candidates.snippet: PR #21962 (closing #21955) randomized the media marker per process, on the basis that at 62^32 "collision is impossible to happen in practice". That holds for *accidental* collision — but `GET /props` publishes the live marker to any unauthenticated caller, so any client that reads it and lets the response reach its prompt history collides with certainty.  This is easy to hit with LLM agents: reading `/props` is the correct capability-discovery call, and the response is then stored as tool outpu
